faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people usually ask before starting.

items.title: How is the cost worked out?
items.content: Every project is different, so there's no fixed price list. Describe what you need, we agree on a clear scope, and I quote you directly. Once it's agreed, there are no hidden fees.

items.title: A student — is the work reliable?
items.content: I'm a final-year Software Engineering student taking on real projects. You get a product built with modern tech and clean code — and I give it my all because it's part of my portfolio too. You're welcome to review past projects before deciding.

items.title: Can you build a site if I don't have a design?
items.content: Yes. Just describe your idea, your field or your goal. I'll advise on content structure, layout and the approach.

items.title: Is the website SEO-optimized?
items.content: Yes. Sites are built with a search-friendly structure, optimized load speed, metadata, a sitemap and the basic technical SEO factors.

items.title: Do you help with domain and hosting?
items.content: Yes. If you don't have them yet, I'll advise on and set up your domain, hosting and related services.

items.title: Is there support after handover?
items.content: Yes. Bugs in code I wrote are fixed free for life. I also walk you through using the site and answer questions after handover. The bug-fix policy doesn't apply once the source code has been changed by you or someone else.
